Sunday, November 30, 2025
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UUN000001vqpP2AQ/
Let’s bid a fond farewell to fall with one final hike! Climb to the summit of Mt. Wataticwith us to take in spectacular views from its open peak that stretch from Mount Greylockin the west to Boston in the east. Ascend on old cart roads through stands of red mapleand white wood asters and then descend back down the rocky western slope to see..abig rock!This 2.8 mile loop with 700’ of elevation gain is expected to take 2-3 hours. It’s a veryapproachable trip for novice hikers with good mobility and those who identify asphysically active. We’ll plan to keep a moderate pace (1.5mph) to ensure we staytogether as a group. This is a popular hike, so you can expect a well-trodden dirt pathon the ascent. The descent from Mount Watatic is rocky and uneven, so you mayappreciate bringing a set of hiking poles.Daytime highs in Ashburnham and Ashby have been ranging from just below freezing(32F) to 50F lately, so make sure you come dressed in layers and prepared for coldweather. Puffy jackets or a similar insulating layer are a must, as well as a hat and set ofgloves/mittens. Mount Watatic’s peak is exposed, so pack a wind-proof outer layer toward off the chill. Trip leaders will be monitoring the weather for icy conditions inadvance since light rain and freeze/thaw conditions are expected in the next coupleweeks.You can expect an email with further details, including the exact meeting time, one weekin advance of the trip.Any cancellations due to weather will be sent out via email the day before the trip.Rain, stormy weather, or icy conditions will cancel this trip.

Tuesday, December 16, 2025 | 6:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UUN000001zWC52AM/
Join the Worcester Chapter 20s & 30s for our annual holiday social at Sterling Street Brewery on Tuesday, December 16 at 6:00 PM! Celebrate the holiday season with light fare and socializing with like-minded 20s & 30s. Learn about how we'll be getting outdoors and staying active this winter season with hiking, skiing, socials, and more. Food will be provided by the 20s & 30s committee. Sterling Street Brewery has alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks for purchase. All are welcome! We look forward to seeing new and returning faces!Our most exciting social of the year will feature an optional Yankee swap and a cookie exchange.Spots are limited! To join the fun, please register. Further details on the Yankee swap and cookie exchange will be sent to those who register.
